title: Just 0.007% Of Earth’s Water Sits In Rivers And Lakes
hook: Just 0.007% of Earth’s water sits in rivers and lakes.
closing: Accessible water is a tiny reserve, so pollution and waste hit far harder than they look.
question: Did you expect so little?

segments.say: Only 3.5% of Earth’s water is fresh, leaving nearly everything around us too salty to drink.
Ice holds 68.7% of freshwater, locking most of that already-small supply beyond easy reach.
Rivers and lakes hold 0.007% of Earth’s water, making our usable surface supply astonishingly thin.
